q2.question:
Build str_rev.c with the appropriate compiler flags and then run it using gdb:

$ gcc -Wall -std=gnu99 -g -o str_rev str_rev.c

$ gdb ./str_rev
...
(gdb) run old school
...
Program received signal SIGSEGV, Segmentation fault.
(gdb) bt
...

Which of the following statements are true (select all that apply)?

responses.strcpy: The program segfaults on the line strncpy(t, s, strlen(s)).
responses.strlen: The program segfaults on the line char *t = malloc(strlen(s)).
responses.longs: The program segfaults because s is too long.
responses.longt: The program segfaults because t is too long.
responses.frees: To fix the segfault, we must call free(s).
responses.freet: To fix the segfault, we must call free(t).
responses.inti: To fix the segfault, we must set int i = 0 in the for loop.
responses.argc: To fix the segfault, we must check i < argc in the for loop.
